title: Full Send Survive
description: A horde survival game where you pick one of nine classes and try to last ten minutes against hundreds of enemies, choosing an upgrade every time you level up, before the zone's boss arrives. Ten zones, harder Heroic and Nightmare tiers, and a weekly challenge leaderboard.
how_to_play: Best on a computer. The first three zones and one hero need no account; signing in with Discord unlocks the rest and co-op for up to four players. The game shows its controls on screen.
